title: Till Midnight
vision: The old East Wing creaks in the dark.
wake: You snap awake at your desk in St. Jude's Ward. The night shift has just begun.

shift-start.text: “Night shift begins. Can you check the old East Wing storage room?”

left.label: Warn Dr. Aris
left.after: He laughs off your warning but looks uneasy.

right.label: Say nothing
right.after: You nod and grab your clipboard quietly.

bleach-spill.text: A bottle of harsh industrial disinfectant tipped over, leaving a slippery film.

left.label: Mop it up
left.after: It takes ten minutes, but the corridor floor is clean and dry.

right.label: Step around it
right.after: You leave the spill for the morning janitorial crew.

supply-room.text: Power flickers. On the counter sits a heavy steel flashlight and a ring of master keys.

left.label: Take flashlight
left.after: Heavy in your hand. The beam is sharp and bright.

right.label: Take master keys
right.after: You slide the heavy key ring into your pocket.

call-button.text: An alarm blares from room 304 upstairs. A patient needs immediate help!

left.label: Sprint up stairs
left.after: You race up the steps two at a time.

right.label: Take elevator
right.after: The doors close slowly. You regain your breath.

oxygen-leak.text: A loud hiss echoes near the gas lines. An oxygen tank pressure gauge is red.

left.label: Tighten valve
left.after: The valve turns with a screech and stops leaking.

right.label: Open window
right.after: Fresh night air rushes in, diluting the fumes.

fire-alarm.text: “I smell burning rubber from the basement shaft! Should we trigger the alarm?”

left.label: Pull fire alarm
left.after: Bells ring across the ward. Staff begin evacuating patients.

right.label: Investigate first
right.after: Nora looks nervous but follows your lead.

aris-talk.text: “You warned me earlier... the ceiling just groaned overhead. We need to get out!”

left.label: Escape together
left.after: He nods, grabbing his emergency kit.

right.label: Tell him to go
right.after: He runs toward the fire escape alone, looking betrayed.

alone-talk.text: The wall cracks beside you. Plaster dust rains down onto your shoulders.

left.label: Shield your head
left.after: A chunk of drywall misses your shoulder.

right.label: Run forward
right.after: You leap past the falling debris.

blackout.text: The main generator fails. Darkness swallows the floor completely.

left.label: Use flashlight
left.after: The bright beam cuts through the pitch black.

right.label: Feel your way
right.after: You drag your hand along the wall slowly.

escape-route.text: The heavy emergency door to the stairs is stuck shut from building tilt.

left.label: Shoulder the door
left.after: You slam your weight into the jammed frame.

right.label: Use window exit
right.after: You slip through the ground floor window frame.

balcony-escape.text: You reach the exterior iron stairwell. It shakes under the building's strain.

left.label: Step out together
left.after: You step onto the metal stairs side by side.

right.label: Go one by one
right.after: He goes first, then you follow safely.

final-stretch.text: You reach the grass. Behind you, the East Wing begins its fatal collapse.

left.label: Look back
left.after: A cloud of dust washes over you as midnight strikes.

right.label: Keep running
right.after: You cross the street as the ground shakes.

slip.title: The Slick Floor
slip.text: You slipped on the wet disinfectant and broke your neck on the marble step.
chain: Disinfectant spilled in the hallway
You decided not to mop it
The alarm rang in room 304
You sprinted down the hallway
Your foot lost traction
slip.hint: Taking a moment to clean spills prevents fatal accidents later.

shaft.title: The Open Shaft
shaft.text: In total darkness, you stepped into an open elevator shaft.
chain: You chose master keys over the torch
The main generator died
You tried to navigate in the pitch black
The elevator doors had warped open
Three stories down
shaft.hint: A source of light in an old building is worth more than keys.

crush.title: The Falling Beam
crush.text: Forcing the stuck door shook the frame, bringing the heavy concrete header down on you.
chain: You entered the East Wing alone
The exit door was jammed tight
You rammed your shoulder into it
The cracked ceiling gave way
crush.hint: When a door is jammed by structural stress, look for a window.

scaffold.title: The Overloaded Stairs
scaffold.text: The rusted iron stairwell collapsed under your combined weight.
chain: You saved Dr. Aris
You reached the exterior fire escape
You both ran onto the stairs together
Rusted bolts snapped from the weight
scaffold.hint: Old metal stairs can't handle two people running at once.

panic.title: Hysteria
panic.text: Overwhelmed by dread, you hid inside a locker as the walls caved in.
chain: You doubted every sound
Your focus disintegrated
Panic froze you in place
panic.hint: Keep your mind sharp by taking steady, decisive action.

collapse.title: Exhaustion
collapse.text: Your legs buckled in the corridor. You couldn't crawl out in time.
chain: You pushed your body past its limit
You collapsed before reaching safety
collapse.hint: Rest when you can; physical stamina keeps you alive.

isolated.title: Left Behind
isolated.text: Nobody knew you were trapped under the debris. No rescue came.
chain: You pushed your colleagues away
No one checked on your position
You died in the dark alone
isolated.hint: Building trust ensures someone looks out for you.

together.title: Midnight
together.text: 00:00. You and Dr. Aris stand on the lawn, watching the East Wing turn to rubble. You made it.

survivor.title: Midnight
survivor.text: 00:00. You stand alone on the grass as the building falls. You survived the night shift.
survivor.hint: There is a way to save Dr. Aris too.
